what_happened.line: A commission member said the town's RFP appraisal for the former gas station at 925 Mass Avenue assumes the site is environmentally clean, though contamination remains unremediated and no monitoring wells exist past the parcel line.

The commission voted 3-0 to send a corrected outreach letter and set an April 16 meeting with the actual trustees of the 50 Main Street condominium property, after the wrong trust had first been contacted.
Members said they would not object to demolishing the existing gas station structure, viewing it as having no historic significance.
The commission set its next meeting for March 12, likely by Zoom.
